items.title: Marquis v. SonicWall Lawsuit Ups the Breach Blame Game
items.description: When a company gets breached through a third-party security vendor, who should bear responsibility? For one FinTech company, the answer is the firewall provider.

items.title: Phishing‑Led Agent Tesla Campaign Uses Process Hollowing and Anti‑Analysis to Evade Detection
items.description: A newly uncovered phishing campaign is delivering Agent Tesla, one of the most widely used credential-stealing malware families, through a multi-stage attack chain that leaves almost no trace on a victim’s machine. items.title: Aeternum C2 Botnet Stores Encrypted Commands on Polygon Blockchain to Evade Takedown
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a new botnet loader called Aeternum C2 that uses a blockchain-based command-and-control (C2) infrastructure to make it resilient to takedown efforts.
